name: Cube of Force

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Press a face
powers.text: Magic action: press a face (1 to 5 charges) to raise a 15-ft cube of force around you that keeps out gas, objects, living things, spells, or everything; face 6 ends it.

summary: Raise a cube of force around yourself that keeps out gases, objects, creatures, spells, or all of them.
text: This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it that can be pressed. The cube starts with 10 charges, and it regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to press one of the cube's faces, expending a number of charges based on the chosen face. Each face has a different effect. If the cube has insufficient charges remaining, nothing happens. Otherwise, a barrier of invisible force springs into existence, forming a cube 15 feet on a side. The barrier is centered on you, moves with you, and lasts for 1 minute, until you take a Magic action to press the cube's sixth face, or the cube runs out of charges. Face 1 (1 charge): gases, wind and fog can't pass through the barrier. Face 2 (2): nonliving matter can't pass through the barrier; walls, floors and ceilings can pass through at your discretion. Face 3 (3): living matter can't pass through the barrier. Face 4 (4): spell effects can't pass through the barrier. Face 5 (5): nothing can pass through the barrier; walls, floors and ceilings can pass through at your discretion. Face 6 (0): the barrier deactivates. The cube loses charges when the barrier is targeted by certain spells or comes into contact with certain spell or magic item effects.
